newsitem.title: FINLAND: Pulp and metals weigh on Finnish '96 export prices.
newsitem.headline: Pulp and metals weigh on Finnish '96 export prices.

text.p: Lower prices for pulp and base metals and slower rises in paper and board prices hit Finnish export prices in 1996, Statistics Finland (SF) said on Friday.

December export prices fell 5.1 percent year-on-year and were down 0.9 percent on November, but export prices rose 0.8 percent on average in 1996 on 1995 after rising seven percent the previous year, Statistics Finland said on Friday.
Export prices for pulp fell 33 percent on average in 1996 on 1995, partly reversing a rise of 46 percent in 1995 on 1994, SF said.
It was the biggest decline in pulp export prices in 20 years, SF said.
Paper and board export prices rose six percent on average in 1996 on 1995 after rising 18 percent in 1995 on 1994, it said.
Export prices for base metals fell six percent on average in 1996 on 1995, after rising 10 percent in 1995, it said.
In December, pulp export prices fell 40 percent year-on-year, base metals export prices dropped almost 16 percent and paper and board export prices were down eight percent, SF said.
